result.summary: The image shows an institutional street environment where pedestrians are crossing a wide, unmarked roadway. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks, traffic control, and lane markings increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians are crossing a wide street without any designated markings or signage to alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where pedestrians are walking across the street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the view between oncoming drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street where the red SUV is parked

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant patching and cracking in the asphalt create an uneven surface for both vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct sidewalk bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add warning signs to alert motorists of the frequent pedestrian activity near the church.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. The presence of trolley tracks in the roadway and a relatively wide crossing distance without a refuge island are notable features of this environment.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway, running parallel to traffic through the intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the street, including tracks, without a mid-point refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the foreground street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, unmarked asphalt roadway with embedded trolley tracks, which creates a complex and potentially hazardous environment for pedestrians. While sidewalks are present, the lack of visible crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals at a signalized junction significantly increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and extending through the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No visible painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection leaves pedestrians without a designated, protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection area

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and traffic signals. However, safety is compromised by the presence of streetcar tracks and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway present a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a crash risk for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally along the center of the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk obstruct visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on both sides of the street approaching the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway increases the risk of trips and falls for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface near the foreground and within the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and further improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces, especially within and around the pedestrian crossing area.
